name: architecture-design
description: Draft and review architecture design documents and ADRs for a design review. Critiques the design itself (right problem first, then each goal traced to its mechanism, contradictions, structure, failure behaviour, decisions, and whether the team can run it), and checks completeness: problem and outcomes, ranked goals, trade-offs, options including doing nothing, decisions with rejected alternatives, migration and the review record. Ships a design document template, an ADR template and a reviewer checklist. Works best with writing-editor for the prose.
